title: chenopodium ambrosioides f. pinnatifidum
intro: Chenopodium ambrosioides f. pinnatifidum, commonly known as Mexican tea or epazote, is a plant species belonging to the Chenopodiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion and relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome, as well as its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Mexican tea include its antiemetic, antispasmodic, and diuretic properties, which can help to alleviate nausea, muscle cramps, and urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of Mexican tea include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and provide potential health benefits.
